neper.notes: The baseline: control.text in the Neper type scale, same samples.

windows.notes: No control.e branch: the Windows tokens already set the body text to 11.2 px regular black (ink width of "Row Color:" is 78 px at 150 %, identical to the Grids options capture). The sheet shows v3's TcxLabel styles read from the DFMs: bold, 13 px, clGray (#808080) hints, disabled, the hot-link style (#336CCC underlined), a clWhite and a clBtnFace background, word wrap and a clipped long label.
gaps: Disabled colour (#6D6D6D, GrayText) is a guess; no captured disabled label
The hot-link underline is a 1 unit line under the text (no underline in control.text); it has no hover state here
The accelerator underline (&Color in v3 captions) is not drawn
Bold needs Segoe UI Bold, now registered as font 9 in e.ui.looks (the harness had regular faces only); bold use in v3 is Tahoma bold, face not confirmed
A clipped label shows no ellipsis (the box clips); v3's AutoSize = False label also just clips
Rotated labels (Properties.Angle = 90) are not drawn
Captured text is ClearType (coloured fringes), ours is grayscale
Two cells with the same text in one sheet failed with InvalidTree in the harness; the sheet avoids duplicates

neper.notes: The baseline: the v2 18 px box in its 40 px state circle, all states.

windows.notes: Rest unchecked and checked match the Options dialog capture at 150 %: 13 unit box (20 px), #F3F3F3 face with #636363 edge, #005FB8 fill with a white tick, caption 2 units after the box in 11.2 px Segoe UI, 21 unit row. Hover, pressed, disabled, indeterminate and the dotted focus rectangle are Windows 11 conventions, not captured.
gaps: Hover, pressed and disabled colours are guesses (Windows 11 conventions); no v3 capture of any non-rest state
Indeterminate (white dash on the accent fill) is not in any v3 capture; no v3 dialog uses a tri-state box
The focus rectangle is a guess: 1 unit black dots every 2 units round the caption (DevExpress draws one; none captured). At 150 % the dots are antialiased, the real ones are 1 physical pixel
The tick is a stroked path (0.8 unit, 75 % white) fitted by eye to the captured glyph, not the Segoe Fluent Icons check
The face #F3F3F3 was measured on the #F0F0F0 dialog face; over a white parent it is probably different (the native face is translucent)
The box is 13 units, so 19.5 px at 150 %; the capture is a crisp 20 px (Windows rounds the glyph to whole pixels)
Mnemonic underline (&Symbol in v3 captions) is not drawn
Caption font is Segoe UI at 11.2 px by the shared tokens; the captured text is ClearType (coloured fringes), ours is grayscale

neper.notes: The baseline: the v2 multi-select list (selection fill, 40 px rows, state circles).

windows.notes: No v3 form uses a TcxCheckListBox (no such class in the DFMs), so there is nothing to match the list against. The rows are the measured native check box mark (see checkbox) at 21 unit row height on a white viewport.
gaps: No v3 reference: the viewport edge (1 unit #ABABAB, square), the 21 unit row height, the 4 unit left inset and the white face are guesses carried over from the combo box and grid measurements
Selection (a highlighted current row, distinct from checked) is not drawn: control.multi_select_list has one flag per row, checked, and no current-row state; DevExpress lfFlat would draw one
Hover has no row highlight, only the mark's own hover colour (guessed, see checkbox); DevExpress check lists do not hot-track rows by default
The focus rectangle round a row's caption is a guess (see checkbox); the harness's Tab sequence lands it on the last row
No disabled state: the control takes no enabled flag
Overflow (more rows than the viewport, a scroll bar) is not shown in the sheet and the scroll bar has no Windows look yet
The count bar variant (multi_select_list_counted) keeps the Neper look

neper.notes: The baseline: v2 radios stacked with no frame.

windows.notes: Frame (1 unit #DCDCDC, 3 unit corners), caption cut into the top edge with its text 7 units in, and the radios match the Grids options page capture at 150 %. v3 spreads the items over the group's fixed height (105 units); this group packs its rows at 21 units.
gaps: v3's TcxRadioGroup has a fixed height (105 in the DFM) and spreads its items evenly over it (about 42 units apart); control.radio_group has no height, so the rows pack at 21 units. Not drawn: the spread
The frame is as wide as its widest row; v3's groups are a fixed 325 units wide
Each radio inherits the radio gaps (hover, pressed, focus are guesses); the disabled caption colour (#6D6D6D) is a guess
The harness holds about four radio groups per sheet (max_states 128 in looks.open): a fifth cell fails with InvalidTree
